page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7ne.24xlarge is an enhanced enterprise-grade virtual server built on KVM virtualization and designed for network-heavy, high-throughput computing environments. Driven by the x86_64 architecture, the instance provides 96 dedicated vCPUs using Intel Xeon 8369HB processors operating at a base frequency of 3.3 GHz. The compute resources are paired with 384.0 GB of system memory, maintaining a balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. It contains no onboard GPUs, focusing strictly on high-concurrency general compute operations.

A primary architectural characteristic of the ecs.g7ne.24xlarge is its networking capability, which delivers an 80 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. This network capacity facilitates massive input/output throughput across distributed architectures. The instance does not include bundled local storage, meaning disk operations rely entirely on attached network block storage volumes. System architectures running on this profile must account for external storage latencies, though the 80 Gbps network interface provides sufficient throughput to sustain high remote storage and inter-node communication traffic.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g7ne.24xlarge aggregates high core counts, substantial memory capacity, and large network pipes into a single hardware footprint. This consolidation minimizes per-node overhead for scaled enterprise deployments. The instance is well-suited for high-throughput distributed applications, API gateways, large web serving fleets, enterprise microservices architectures, caching layers, and multi-node batch data processing jobs that demand consistent dedicated CPU execution and high network transfer rates.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g7ne.24xlarge is an x86_64 general-purpose server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 96 dedicated Intel Xeon 8369HB vCPUs clocked at 3.3 GHz, coupled with 384.0 GB of system memory to sustain a balanced 4.0 GB per core ratio. The instance is architected without integrated GPUs or local storage, necessitating external storage volumes for data persistence. Its most prominent hardware specification is a high-bandwidth network interface providing an 80 Gbps baseline throughput. This setup ensures substantial inter-server data transfer capacity and low congestion in distributed clusters. The configuration presents an efficient consolidation platform for enterprise workloads, eliminating local hardware disk maintenance while maximizing network performance. The ecs.g7ne.24xlarge is suitable for large-scale application tiers, network-intensive distributed services, caching clusters, and high-concurrency enterprise web serving.
